# How to register a UK limited company online from abroad (2026)

**Yes, you can register a UK Limited Company while living outside the UK.** You do not need to be a UK citizen, UK resident, or physically present in Britain.

However, there is an important change to the cost: as of November 2026, the official Companies House online registration fee is **£100, not £50**\.

You can still do the registration yourself without paying an expensive company formation agent.

# £100

**Official online incorporation fee**

Registration time **Usually 24 hours**

Can apply from abroad? (Yes)

UK-resident director required? **No**

Source: Companies House official guidance. [www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/limited-company-formation/register-your-company?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/limited-company-formation/appoint-directors-and-company-secretaries?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/companies-house-fees/companies-house-fees?ioc=1&locale=en-GB&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 1\. What you need

Before registering, prepare\:

- A proposed company name.
- Your passport or other accepted identity document.
- Your residential address abroad.
- A UK registered office address.
- Your business activity (SIC code).
- Details of shareholders and directors.
- Your share structure (for example, 1 ordinary share worth £1).

You can be the sole director and sole shareholder.

## 2\. Register directly with the UK government

Use the official government website\:

**[Register a limited company – GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/limited-company-formation/register-your-company)**

The process is\:

1. Check whether your company name is available.
2. Choose a private company limited by shares (Ltd).
3. Enter your director details.
4. Enter shareholder details.
5. Provide your UK registered office address.
6. Select your SIC business activity code.
7. Complete the identity verification requirements.
8. Pay the £100 registration fee.
9. Receive your certificate of incorporation.

Companies House will usually process a straightforward application within 24 hours. [www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/limited-company-formation/register-your-company?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/incorporation-and-names/incorporation-and-names?ssr_id=ssr_id%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 3\. How to get a UK registered office address

This is particularly important if you live abroad.

Every UK limited company needs a registered office in the UK. You can use a commercial registered-office service rather than renting an office.

Typical advertised prices vary, but budget approximately £30–£100+ per year for a basic service.

Make sure the address is in the correct UK jurisdiction\:

- England and Wales
- Scotland
- Northern Ireland

The address must be an appropriate physical address where official correspondence can be received. [www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/limited-company-formation/appoint-directors-and-company-secretaries?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.hollowaydavies.co.uk](https://www.hollowaydavies.co.uk/blog/incorporation-and-structure/register-limited-company-uk-non-resident-director?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 4\. Identity verification when living abroad

Since 18 November 2025, identity verification has been a legal requirement for company directors.

You need to obtain a Companies House personal code. You can start through\:

[Official Companies House identity verification guidance](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/verifying-your-identity-for-companies-house)\.

Check which identity verification route is available for your passport and country. An authorised Companies House agent (ACSP) is another option. [www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/verifying-your-identity-for-companies-house?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/when-you-need-to-verify-your-identity-for-companies-house?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 5\. What will the total cost be?

| Item | Estimated cost |
|--------|--------|
| Companies House registration | £100 |
| Registered office (one year) | £30–£100+ |
| DIY preparation | £0 |
| **Estimated first-year total** | **£130–£200+** |


There is also a £50 annual confirmation statement filing fee. Accounting, tax returns and other compliance services may cost extra. [www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/limited-company-formation/register-your-company?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/limited-company-formation/appoint-directors-and-company-secretaries?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/companies-house-fees/companies-house-fees?ioc=1&locale=en-GB&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/incorporation-and-names/incorporation-and-names?ssr_id=ssr_id%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)
